current_date: Adopted January 2026 (Notice of Adoption dated 26 March 2026)
current_evidence: The council's Local Validation List page (ipswich.gov.uk/localvalidationlist) links this PDF as 'Ipswich Borough Council Local Validation List (Adopted January 2026)' alongside a Notice of Adoption dated 26 March 2026; the cover says 'Adopted January 2026'.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the list makes several local items apply to all applications including householder: Block Plans, Elevations, Floor Plans (all applications), Roof Plans (roof changes), Site Sections (sloping sites for householder works), Street Scene (large side extensions, roof pitch changes, front alterations), plus Heritage Statement, Tree Survey and Archaeology where triggered.
issues.evidence: Block Plans / Elevations / Floor Plans - 'All applications'; Site Sections - 'sloping sites for householder works'

issues.detail: Listed building consent is recorded as '(none)', but the list requires a Design and Access Statement for listed building consent, a Heritage Statement, Joinery and Architectural Details for replacement of traditional features, and a Structural Survey and Method Statement where relevant.
issues.evidence: Design and Access Statement: 'listed building consent'; Heritage Statement: 'affects a heritage asset, its setting'; Joinery and Architectural Details item

issues.detail: Local items in the source not captured anywhere by Grokbot: Roof Plans (roof shape/appearance changes); Joinery and Architectural Details (replacing traditional features on heritage assets); Application Summary (major apps with >100 pages of supporting material); Community Consultation Exercise Statement (all major); Disability Access Statement (10+ homes); Habitat Management and Monitoring Plan (all major); Housing Delivery Statement (temporary car parks on housing allocations); Minerals Assessment (minerals consultation area, Policy MP10); Planning Statement; Site Waste Management Statement; Structural Survey and Method Statement; Telecommunications Report; Theatre Assessment; Tall Building Assessment; Additional strategies for Ipswich Garden Suburb developments; Economic Impact Assessment trigger (major apps losing E(g)/B2/B8 land).
issues.evidence: Contents page / Local Validation Requirements table of the Adopted January 2026 list
issues.grok_comment: Most listed items are indeed absent, but the Full planning "Schedule of works (listed building)" row quotes "A schedule of works necessary to preserve the building" from the Structural Survey and Method Statement item, so that requirement is partly captured, though mislabelled.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Structural Survey is partly captured under a mislabelled row. The other missing items stand.

issues.detail: Most of the 25 tab_items are process text, boilerplate or fragments, not requirements: validation timescales ('validated within two working days', 'ten working days'), 'Invalid applications...', 'You should not include personal information about third parties', the page's link/consultation text, policy citations with URL fragments ('files/core_strategy...', 'ploads/system/uploads/...'), and three items taken from the HRA screening report ('European wildlife sites are those designated as SPA and SAC', 'The Stour and Orwell Estuaries SPA ... lies partly within Ipswich Borough').
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements' sections; HRA Screening Report source

issues.detail: Drawing standards items duplicated ('The scale of the drawing and paper size' twice; 'Any revisions to the drawings should be clearly identified with a revision number' twice, once prefixed with page-header text 'Page 28 of 99 Item When and What required Sources').

Many trigger excerpts are page-header/fragment text or belong to a different item: Marketing/vacancy evidence uses lighting text ('how the lighting may affect: Local character'); Sequential/Exception Test (flood) and Waste storage both use the Retail Impact Assessment header ('Retail Impact Assessment / Sequential Test When and What required Sources Plan.'); Ventilation/Extraction uses Open Space text; Employment Statement is just '(Protection of Employment Land) Page 51 of 99 Item When and What required'; Odour/Dust uses the Noise heading. Real triggers (e.g. Marketing: loss of community facility/pub/employment land per DM24/DM28/DM30/DM33; Affordable Housing: 15+ dwellings or 0.5ha+) are not stated.
issues.evidence: Marketing Information - DM30, DM33, DM24, DM28 triggers; Affordable Housing Statement - '15+ dwellings or sites of 0.5ha+'

issues.detail: About 45 requirements are placed under Full planning with the note 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning' even where the source gives explicit scopes (e.g. Street Scene 'all major applications' and householder works; Community Consultation 'all major'; Landscaping 'major and minor in sensitive landscape'; Construction Management Plan 'full applications and reserved matters'). Outline gets only 5 items, two of which are wrong (see next issue).

Outline rows 'Environmental Statement (EIA)', 'Equality / accessibility statement' and 'Habitats Regulations Assessment' take their trigger text from the SEA screening report, the Equality Impact Assessment and the HRA screening report about the list itself, not from validation requirements. 'Equality / accessibility statement' isn't a requirement in the list.
issues.evidence: Trigger 'Appendix 5 - Equality Impact Assessment of the Ipswich Borough Council Local Validation List'; 'Yes - the Local Validation List is prepared for town and country planning'

issues.detail: Construction Management Plan is recorded as a requirement, but the source says it is not a formal validation requirement (only strongly encouraged).
issues.evidence: Construction Management Plan - 'not a formal validation requirement ... strongly encouraged'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current list (adopted January 2026), but the extraction is poor. Householder and listed building consent wrongly show no local requirements, about 15 local items are missing, and most tab items and trigger excerpts are fragments, process text or text from the wrong item or a supporting report.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
